item.tib: theg pa chen po dmar khrid dug lnga rang grol gyi rgyud las skyabs gnas bla ma'i nang sgrub bo
item.coloph: ces skyabs gnas bla ma'i nang gi sgrub pa 'di yang / kun bzang dgongs pa'i lung bstan ltar/ khyung dkar sprang 'khyams bstan 'dzin rin chen gyis gang dran 'di rnams/ bal bod sa mtshams sbas yul gnam sgo zla gam can du smras pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
